title: Coding assistants in the editor: complete, refactor and document

videos.script: An assistant in your editor looks as if it reads your whole project. It reads what the editor sends it. {{context}} In this lesson you see that request byte by byte, with a small assistant written for the course. You see which files go in, and which secret leaves your machine because nothing stopped it. {{leak}} Then you judge what comes back. A completion that refuses for the wrong reason, where the tests cannot see it. {{tests}} A refactoring that passes every test and does not do what was asked. {{refactor}} A docstring example that turns out to be right, while the code is wrong. {{doctest}} The habit under all three is the same. Write down what the code must do, then let the assistant try, then check. {{habit}} At the end, the three modes, from a line of ghost text to an agent that runs commands. And the cases where the right choice is not to use one at all. {{modes}}
